supports: AED 94.50 original price and AED 51.98 offer price
22 mg zinc as zinc picolinate per tablet

Pregnancy, nursing, medication and medical-condition precautions

content_decisions: The verdict is conditional because 22 mg is 200% of the label daily value and should be used for a defined nutritional need.
The carousel does not claim disease prevention or treatment.
The verified original UAE price shown on artwork is AED 94.50; the offer and retailer remain only in evidence.
The copper and antibiotic-interaction cautions are included because they are specifically supported by NIH evidence.
